result.summary: The page is generally functional and well structured. Only minor visual polish issues are apparent: slight misalignment of the delivery location icon with the address text, and harsh overlapping edges on the promotional banner's decorative shapes.

issues.description: The delivery address text and the location-pin icon are slightly misaligned, with the icon sitting a little higher and to the left of the address line.
issues.suggestion: Vertically center the pin icon with the address text and align it to the text baseline.

issues.description: The promotional banner's decorative circular shapes on the right side have hard, visibly overlapping edges that look like clipping artifacts rather than an intentional smooth graphic.
issues.suggestion: Smooth or simplify the decorative shapes, or reduce their opacity so the overlaps are less visually jarring.
